name: jev-router
description: Routes each task, and every subagent, to a model tier using TypeSafe's Jev.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Bearer key for api.typesafe.ai. Without it the mod does nothing.

minConfidence.title: Minimum Jev confidence
minConfidence.description: Below this, the default model is kept.

showMain.title: Show suggestion for main prompts
showMain.description: Display Jev's pick in the purple line above the prompt for each prompt you submit.

prices.title: Model prices (USD per million tokens)
prices.description: JSON of [input, output] per model family, used to estimate savings. Estimates only.

switchMain.title: Switch the main model
switchMain.description: Run each main turn on the model Jev picks, when that is expected to cost less than staying. Off: suggestion only.

downgradeOnly.title: Only switch to cheaper models
downgradeOnly.description: Never move the main conversation to a pricier model than the one you chose.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long a model keeps the conversation cached after its last request. Used to weigh what a switch costs.
